name: Wind check
description: A preflight check that the wind is under 8 m/s, from the vehicle's own wind estimate or a speed set by hand.

commands.name: set-wind
commands.title: Set the wind by hand
commands.description: Uses this wind speed for the check instead of the vehicle's estimate, such as one read from a handheld anemometer.

commands.name: use-estimate
commands.title: Use the vehicle's wind estimate
commands.description: Goes back to the wind the vehicle estimates for the check.
